About this item

  • Simultaneous 9-Device Charging: The comprehensive family power hub includes a docking station and 3 packs of 10,000mAh power banks. With built-in USB-C ports, USB-C cables, and iOS cables, the entire set allows you to charge up to 9 devices at once—making it perfect for families, teams, or travelers.
  • Always Ready "Grab-and-Go" Design: The portable power station charges all portable chargers simultaneously, keeping them fully powered at all times. Simply grab a 10000mAh portable charger power bank on your way out and dock the used one when you return, ensuring you never deal with a dead battery again.
  • Ultra-Portable & Personalized: Each slim, lightweight battery pack (4.3 x 2.6 x 0.7 inches, 6.42 oz) easily fits in a bag or pocket. The kit also includes 7 theme-based sticker sheets (140 patterns), letting you and your family customize the blank side of your power banks.
  • Advanced & Safe Thimble Charging: Utilizing highly conductive metal thimble technology for stable current transmission, the dock charges efficiently while remaining completely safe. All units are safety-certified to stay below 45°C (113°F), meaning a slight, normal warmth signals peak performance, not a defect.
  • Smart Indicators & Full Protection: Equipped with a high-quality smart chip to prevent overcharging and short circuits. The portable charger shifts through 4 colors (Red/Green/Blue/Cyan) to show precise battery levels (25%–100%), while the dock’s battery symbol glows dimly during charging and stays steady when full.

  • Can this power bank charge multiple devices simultaneously?

    Yes, it features 9 output ports for charging multiple devices at once.

  • Can it be used for air travel?

    Yes, it is travel-friendly due to its lightweight and compact design, and it complies with airline safety regulations for carry-on.

  • How many power banks can the charging base charge at the same time?

    The charging base can charge all power banks at the same time, that is, 3.

  • Will this product come with stickers?

    Yes, this product comes with 108 personalized stickers so you can create a customized power bank with your family, friends, and colleagues!

  • Is this charging dock compatible with power banks from other brands?

    This charging dock is only compatible with the included GOODaaa power bank. Using other brands may damage the dock and pose serious fire hazards.

    About this Item

    • Simultaneous 9-Device Charging: The comprehensive family power hub includes a docking station and 3 packs of 10,000mAh power banks. With built-in USB-C ports, USB-C cables, and iOS cables, the entire set allows you to charge up to 9 devices at once—making it perfect for families, teams, or travelers.
    • Always Ready "Grab-and-Go" Design: The portable power station charges all portable chargers simultaneously, keeping them fully powered at all times. Simply grab a 10000mAh portable charger power bank on your way out and dock the used one when you return, ensuring you never deal with a dead battery again.
    • Ultra-Portable & Personalized: Each slim, lightweight battery pack (4.3 x 2.6 x 0.7 inches, 6.42 oz) easily fits in a bag or pocket. The kit also includes 7 theme-based sticker sheets (140 patterns), letting you and your family customize the blank side of your power banks.
    • Advanced & Safe Thimble Charging: Utilizing highly conductive metal thimble technology for stable current transmission, the dock charges efficiently while remaining completely safe. All units are safety-certified to stay below 45°C (113°F), meaning a slight, normal warmth signals peak performance, not a defect.
    • Smart Indicators & Full Protection: Equipped with a high-quality smart chip to prevent overcharging and short circuits. The portable charger shifts through 4 colors (Red/Green/Blue/Cyan) to show precise battery levels (25%–100%), while the dock’s battery symbol glows dimly during charging and stays steady when full.

    Product Description

    The 3-in-1 portable power station combines three 10,000mAh power bank supplies and a charging dock. Simply place the chargers back into the charging dock and power battery bank will automatically start charging via the thimble input, ensuring that the power bank is always at 100% capacity.The GOODaaa portable power bank comes with built-in iOS and Type-C cables. This portable battery pack is slim, portable, and plug-and-play compatible with smartphones, iPads, bluetooth headsets, and many other devices. It is equipped with an intelligent protection system that effectively prevents overcharging, overvoltage, overcurrent, overheating and short-circuit, providing you with a worry-free and safe experience.
